scope: Eight complete published reader essays plus the index promise, four-step reading route and ordinary-reader introduction, independently rewritten in German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean.
canonical_source: The eight bilingual Markdown files in data/ai-work remain the only canonical primary prose. The adapter reads @@ ZH directly and splits list blocks into individual items; no parallel JSON source copy is created.
source_reading: Lead and source-preparation editor read all eight Chinese essays in full. Lead read the complete original builder, index context and outside-body source notices. Original Markdown hashes, 24 original reading bodies and nine complete main areas captured before expansion.
boundaries: Complete reader prose, not outlines, paper summaries or translations of an abbreviated foreign edition.
Eight essays share one theory source, methodology paper eight; do not invent eight distinct paper counterparts.
Preserve eight authorial turning-point passages, seventeen unordered list items, four emphases, all examples, numbers, practical questions and qualifications.
The final five percent is a metaphor, not a human-word quota. Transparency depends on the writing context.
Access, challenge and exit are proposed protections, not guarantees of present products or existing legal entitlements.
A useful model does not occupy the user's stakes in this interaction; do not turn this into a prediction about every future artificial system.
Multiple models may improve evidence; weigh actual source independence rather than replacing inquiry with votes.
integration: Preserve all primary prose and original publication date. Add five standalone language directories, same-article switches, source routes, discovery, search and analytics. Keep the original flagship card class.
deployment: Audit each complete language edition before sealing; local commit only, no push.
editorial_result: All forty complete foreign essays actually read by a different editor from their author, including every ancillary field. Forty-two listed local corrections applied after Chinese comparison and complete affected-field non-author readback. One French sentence was refined twice and reread again. No summary substitute or primary-prose replacement.
technical_result: Five native indexes and forty article pages, same-article eight-language switches and all original reading modes checked. Original index promise and route lead the cards; afterword remains after. Full final checks and browser proof recorded in publication-qa.json.
